title: Personal Credit Cards: age limits, security deposit and secured graduation terms by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: age limits, security deposit and secured graduation terms

This quick reference belongs to the Personal Credit Cards product line of Piedmont Crescent Bank. It sets out, for every card tier, the age limits measured at application, whether a cash security deposit must be held, the smallest deposit accepted, and the terms on which a secured card is reviewed for graduation.

## Tier table

| Card tier | Youngest age at application | Oldest age at application | Security deposit required | Smallest deposit accepted | Graduation review | Tier graduated into |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 18 years | no maximum | yes | 300.00 USD | 8 months after opening | Cash Rewards Visa |
| College Rewards Visa | 18 years | 25 years | no | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 18 years | no maximum | no | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 18 years | no maximum | no | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 21 years | no maximum | no | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 21 years | no maximum | no | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |

## What each term means

- **Youngest age at application**: the youngest age, in whole years at application, at which the card may be opened.
- **Oldest age at application**: the oldest age, in whole years at application, for the card; "no maximum" means the tier sets no upper age.
- **Security deposit required**: whether a cash security deposit equal to the credit limit must be held.
- **Smallest deposit accepted**: the smallest security deposit the tier accepts.
- **Graduation review**: the number of months after opening at which a secured card is reviewed for graduation.
- **Tier graduated into**: the card tier a secured card graduates into.

## Entry checks attached to each tier

| Card tier | Checks attached to the tier at entry |
|---|---|
| Secured Visa | age at least the youngest age; security deposit at least the smallest deposit accepted |
| College Rewards Visa | age at least the youngest age and no more than the oldest age |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa, Cash Rewards Visa, Travel Rewards Visa Signature | age at least the youngest age |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | age at least the youngest age; the applicant holds Private Client Checking |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical applicants)

- A hypothetical applicant who is 20 in whole years on the application date meets the age limits of Secured Visa, College Rewards Visa, Platinum Low Rate Visa and Cash Rewards Visa, and is below the youngest age of Travel Rewards Visa Signature and Visa Infinite Private Client.
- A hypothetical applicant who is 26 is above the oldest age of College Rewards Visa; no other tier sets an oldest age.
- A hypothetical Secured Visa deposit of 250.00 USD is below the smallest deposit accepted; a deposit of 300.00 USD meets it.

**Q: Does any tier other than Secured Visa take a security deposit?**
A: No. Only Secured Visa requires a deposit; for every other tier the deposit and graduation terms are marked not applicable.
